name: Log Windows Hosts File Hash
description: Append the SHA-256 hash of the Windows hosts file to a log on a schedule. The file silently redirects hostnames, so a hash that changes between entries reveals an edit by malware or an installer that nothing else recorded.
commandTemplate: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-FileHash C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash, Path | Out-File -Append '{{logPath}}'"

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where to append the hash on each run. The hash alone does not say what changed, so keep a copy of the file you trust to compare against when it differs.
